coverage.headline: Multiplan Update: August 2026
coverage.summary: The MDL continued to advance with no July case management conference held; the next conference was scheduled for August 14, 2026. The court also approved 17 more insurers as defendants and rejected legal defenses aimed at limiting provider recovery.

coverage.headline: MultiPlan antitrust litigation gains momentum after rulings for providers
coverage.summary: Plaintiffs are seeking damages exceeding $100 billion before mandatory trebling, with the MDL carrying both class-action and individual tracks; the first bellwether trial is scheduled for December 2027.

coverage.headline: MultiPlan Price-Fixing Lawsuit – New July 2026 Case Update
coverage.summary: Co-lead counsel's firm reports the Arizona Medical Association joined the MDL in March 2026 and the Maryland State Medical Society filed a new direct antitrust case in February 2026; plaintiffs are pressing the court to compel production of MultiPlan's pricing software code.

coverage.headline: Claritev Corp Form 8-K: Grand Jury Proceeding Closed, Civil Investigative Demand Received
coverage.summary: Claritev disclosed via SEC filing that the DOJ's antitrust grand jury proceeding was closed on June 17, 2026 with no criminal charges, but the company separately received a civil investigative demand from the DOJ on May 19, 2026 and is cooperating.

coverage.headline: What to know about MultiPlan's litigation saga
coverage.summary: Becker's chronicles the full sweep of Claritev/MultiPlan's legal exposure, including a May 2026 Capitol Forum report of a DOJ criminal price-fixing probe and Claritev's denial, alongside ongoing MDL discovery and related Zelis litigation.

coverage.headline: Claritev Corp Form 8-K: Response to DOJ Criminal Antitrust Probe Reports
coverage.summary: In response to a May 14, 2026 news article alleging a DOJ criminal antitrust probe, Claritev disclosed it had received a confidential grand jury subpoena in August 2024 but stated it had never been informed it was a target of the investigation.

coverage.headline: DOJ Launches Criminal Antitrust Probe into Claritev
coverage.summary: The Capitol Forum reported that the DOJ's antitrust division opened a criminal price-fixing investigation into Claritev (formerly MultiPlan) over its role in setting out-of-network reimbursement rates for major health insurers.

coverage.headline: MultiPlan, Zelis antitrust cases and pricing risk
coverage.summary: HFMA analysis details how MultiPlan's platform allegedly facilitated $19 billion in underpayments in 2020 alone, with damages subject to mandatory trebling; bellwether trials involving Adventist, Ascension, CHS, and Texas Health Resources are set for December 2027.

coverage.headline: TMA Joins MDL Against Claritev And Major Insurers
coverage.source: Hoodline (sourcing Texas Medical Association / Houston Business Journal)
coverage.summary: The Texas Medical Association, representing more than 60,000 physicians, joined MDL No. 3121, alleging Claritev acted as a central hub for insurers' pricing decisions to suppress out-of-network reimbursements.
